concept.reason: Primary measured osteology plus actual fossil photographs and scale-bearing skeleton reconstruction suffice.

classification: Sylviornithidae, stem galliform; not a ratite or extant megapode
scope: Complete heavy flightless island bird with deep crested bill, thick neck, short wings, stout legs. Subsequent pool, not frozen72.

scale.status: Published reconstruction approximately 0.8–0.85m resting height, not 1.7m upright height or measured individual.
scale.measurement_note: Limb lengths are sample means, skull measurements a separate fossil labeled S.cf.neocaledoniae in2005. They are NOT one articulated individual.

diagnostic_targets: Deep laterally compressed bill with hooked tip; broad posterior head.
Real dorsal bony rostral ornament, not a floppy chicken comb or rhinoceros horn.
Thick curved neck and large heavy feathered oval body, short restrained tail.
Two reduced folded wings visible against trunk, not flight-feather fans.
Stout terrestrial legs, three forward toes and rear hallux, short robust claws; no webbing or exaggerated mound-digging talons.
Muted brown plumage and subdued bill surface are reconstruction choices, not fossil colors.
uncertainties: 2016 skeleton Fig15 is composite reconstruction; missing bones shaded and pelvis inferred from Leipoa.
Fig15 does not reconstruct rhamphotheca; use restrained thin keratin contour over fossil bill, not an oversized invented sheath.
2005 Pindai cranial specimens labeled cf.neocaledoniae; genus morphology is useful, but no claim that they belong to same individual as limb means.
Soft body, feathers, skin covering and ornament color are uncertain. Do not copy bright naked skin as fossil fact.
acceptance: Whole heavy flightless bird, deep bill and real dorsal ornament retained.
Resting scale0.85m and source-measurement distinctions preserved.
Four exact GLB views and two reproducible builds, then independent QA.
